parsed.note_claim: The passport image is AI-generated and falsely attributed to Pam Bondi, who is of Italian-American heritage.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: However, there is no evidence the image authentically depicts an Israeli passport belonging to Bondi. It was generated with artificial intelligence and originated from a social media account that describes itself as satirical.
